Mail.app compatibility and acceptance

SpamWise targets macOS 27 and Apple Mail. The package and app require Swift 6.4 / Xcode 27 for development. Builds and runtime checks in this repository used an Apple-silicon Mac. Intel execution and older macOS versions are unverified; do not lower the deployment target as a compatibility claim. Apple's on-device classifier also requires Apple Intelligence availability and downloaded model assets. Provider availability is checked at runtime and never causes a silent model substitution.

Observed account behavior

The matrix below comes from signed-app probes with generated cross-account messages. It describes those probes, not blanket provider certification; open coverage is tracked in TODO.md, and the live Mail follow-up records the newer workflows.

Mail.app account Apple Events connection Inbox/Junk round trip Orange flag Offline/reconnect Newer workflows
iCloud Passed Passed Passed Pending Confirmed Junk then read status, historical preview, renamed-folder fail-closed, closed-window and relaunch scanning
Google Passed Passed Passed Pending Pending
Exchange / Microsoft 365 in Mail Not tested Not tested Not tested Not tested Not tested
Other accounts in Mail Not tested Not tested Not tested Not tested Not tested

Probes are sent from another account so that the receiving account holds no Sent copy with the same Message-ID; same-account duplicates are ambiguous and left untouched. A move immediately after self-sent mail arrived proved unstable: Mail later put the message in Recovered Messages. After each move, SpamWise polls the message every two seconds and confirms the move after two consecutive matching observations, giving up after 30 seconds. Once those 30 seconds have passed it checks again, and records the outcome as unconfirmed if the message is no longer the destination's only copy; the disposable probe instead waits the full 30 seconds before each move counts. That is an observation of Mail's local state, not a server acknowledgement, and the Apple Events handlers rewritten since these probes still need a fresh signed run.

Mail's account-specific special Inbox/Junk roles are used for moves; SpamWise does not guess a destination by name. Check Mailboxes, under each account's Advanced disclosure in Settings → Accounts, reads those roles without reading message bodies or enabling actions. Names alone do not prove Gmail system labels. During authorized probe cleanup, Mail's Google Trash role mapped to a custom Deleted Messages folder; operator cleanup required exact-message Gmail system TRASH verification. The product exposes no Trash/delete action. A Junk role must be validated on its own, not inferred from the behavior of another role.

Incoming routes

The signed Apple Events route polls Mail.app and supports bounded account/folder sweeps. It needs SpamWise and Mail running on an awake Mac, Automation permission, and available message sources. Keep dry run enabled for comparisons with SpamSieve and server rules. Their classifications and folder membership are not human labels.

Mail also lists SpamWise's MailKit extension, which returns no decision for any message. MailKit messages carry no account identity SpamWise can trust, so the extension cannot pick an account's own Junk mailbox; all filtering happens through the Apple Events sweeps above.

Repeatable acceptance matrix

For each configured account, use uniquely identified, disposable cross-account mail and retain its exact identities. Record initial role mapping, delivery time, first scan time, decision path, source mailbox, intended action and settled outcome. Exercise Inbox delivery, server-routed folders, repeated sweeps, restart, wake, reconnect and a changing multi-page mailbox. Compare two filters with SpamWise in dry run first. Never send ordinary Junk through training automatically.

New workflows also need explicit selected corrections, Junk restore, mark-as-read, dedicated training-folder placement from a second device, and renamed/missing-folder checks. Only generated messages may be used for action probes. Clean up their exact received/Sent/draft copies when finished, without emptying Trash or touching ordinary Junk. Preserve unexplained gaps and uncertain actions as failures, not successes.
